.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.frame-wrap,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-settings,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-state-settings{margin-inline:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);max-width:none}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.frame-wrap{max-width:calc(100% + 8px)}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-settings,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-state-settings{padding-inline:14px}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.section-heading h2{padding-inline:0}
.expanded-global-controls,.expanded-state-controls{padding-inline:4px;margin-inline-start:calc(22px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset))}
.expanded-global-controls>#global-style-controls{margin-inline:-4px;padding-inline:4px}
#perspective-replay{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
.panel>.feather-notice>details>.licence-text{margin-inline-start:calc(26px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset) - var(--optical-offset));padding-inline:20px}
/* Disclosure chevrons get their own measured ink correction; body text shares
   the summary's text position, not the enclosing panel's edge. */
.panel>details:not(.preview-settings):not(.preview-state-settings)>:not(summary),.panel>.feather-notice>details>:not(summary){margin-inline-start:calc(26px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset,5.25px))}
/* Nested grey specimen surfaces, swatches and catalogues own the same rails. */
.playground-icon-entry{padding-inline:28px}
.swatch strong,.swatch code,.swatch small{padding-inline:16px}.swatch p{margin-inline:16px}
/* Square textareas, tables and code listings deliberately stay on the text rail. */
#worm-copy-fallback,#perspective-copy-fallback{display:block}#worm-copy-fallback[hidden],#perspective-copy-fallback[hidden]{display:none}
.inspector-dock{padding-inline:max(28px,calc((100vw - 1112px)/2))}
.inspector-dock .inspector-bar,.inspector-dock .inspector-actions{margin-inline:-4px}
/* Sources already render their link interiors; align the whole link surface. */
.panel>a.workshop-link,.playground-icon-entry>a.workshop-link,.link-examples section>a.workshop-link{margin-inline-start:-4px}
.frame-wrap{padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.panel:not(.is-expanded)>.frame-wrap{overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:hidden}

ul:not([role])>li+li{margin-top:8px}
ul:not([role]) ul{margin-block:8px}
code,kbd,samp{font-family:var(--body-code-font)}

/* Fixed source-width examples must not trigger mobile text inflation.
   Page zoom remains available. */
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:none;text-size-adjust:none}
/* One content inset. The surrounding iframe adds none. */
body{margin:0;padding-block:24px;padding-inline:0;background:var(--page);color:var(--text);overflow-y:hidden}
:is(#type-specimens,#icon-catalog,#error-catalog,#focus-catalog,#link-type-specimens){padding-inline:var(--specimen-text-rail)}
html[data-specimen-gallery=icons] body{padding-bottom:16px}
html:is([data-specimen-gallery=icons],[data-specimen-gallery=errors]) body{font:14px/1.5 system-ui}
:is(.type-row,.agent-row,.notice-type-row,.icon-row,.focus-row){padding-block:24px;padding-inline:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
#type-specimens>.type-row:first-child,#icon-catalog .icon-row[data-first-visible],#errors-resources>.icon-row:first-child,#focus-resources>.focus-row:first-child{padding-top:0}
[data-gallery-last]{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
:is(.icon-row,.focus-row)>h3{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 16px}
:is(.icon-row,.focus-row)>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.icon-row:not(:has([data-icon-source]:not([hidden])))>.icon-meta{margin-bottom:0}
.icon-meta{font:12px/1.6 ui-monospace,monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:var(--muted-text)}
.focus-meta{font:12px/1.6 monospace;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sample-label{font:600 12px/1.5 system-ui;color:var(--muted-text);margin:0 0 16px}
.sample-label code{font-family:ui-monospace,monospace}
:is(.type-row,.agent-row,.notice-type-row) output{display:block;margin-top:16px;font:12px/1.6 monospace;color:var(--muted-text);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#type-specimens>:last-child>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* Scroll clearance, not a second content inset. The viewport reaches the grey
   boundary; its gutter restores the existing rail and protects focus paint. */
:is(.icon-sample,.focus-preview,.agent-preview,.prompt-specimen-viewport,.feedback-preview,.specimen-viewport,.variant-preview){margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--specimen-text-rail));padding:16px 0 16px var(--specimen-text-rail);width:calc(100% + 2 * var(--specimen-text-rail));max-width:none;box-sizing:border-box;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:hidden}
[data-specimen-scroll-end]::after{content:"";display:block;width:var(--specimen-scroll-end);height:0}
.prompt-specimen-viewport{padding-block:8px;margin-block:-8px}
.specimen-viewport{padding-block:8px;margin-block:-8px}
.error-sample{display:flow-root}
.error-sample:has(.full-login-context){padding-block:24px 64px}
@media(max-width:660px){.error-sample:has(.full-login-context){padding-block:20px 32px}}
#errors-resources .fallback-context{outline:1px solid var(--border);outline-offset:-1px;border-radius:12px}
.fallback-context{margin:0}
.fallback-context .step-row,.fallback-context .step-row>*{opacity:1;transform:none}
.error-sample pre,.icon-sample [data-unicode-target] pre{max-height:240px}

/* One rounded-boundary adjustment. !important only defeats captured inline
   margins or isolation resets; it does not compete with other gallery offsets. */
:is(.icon-sample,.focus-preview,.agent-preview,.variant-preview,.feedback-preview)>:is(button,.toggle,.theme-toggle,.symbol,.password-field,.qr-card,.code-wrap,.javascript-notice,.full-login-context,.fallback-context),
.type-row [data-in-situ],.type-row [data-type-sample].gate-submit,
.type-row footer button[data-type-sample],.notice-type-row .javascript-notice,
.focus-footer>form{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))!important}
.notice-type-row .javascript-notice{margin-block:0}
.selection-example{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));padding-inline:16px}
.icon-row>a.workshop-link{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));margin-top:16px}
/* A source boundary owns its measured width. The viewport scrolls instead of
   forcing this component through the gallery's narrower responsive layout. */
[data-specimen-width]{width:var(--specimen-width)!important;min-width:var(--specimen-width)!important;max-width:none!important;flex-shrink:0}
.error-sample>.code-wrap,.error-sample>.step-anchor{position:relative}
/* Step labels keep the text rail; their copy indicator uses the authorised gutter. */
.icon-sample>.step-anchor{margin-inline-start:0!important}
.feedback-preview .code-wrap{height:auto;overflow:visible}
.feedback-preview .status{position:absolute}

/* Optical exceptions move the specimen only, without redefining its inset. */
.focus-preview{--specimen-optical-nudge:0px}
.focus-preview:has(>.segmented-toggle){--specimen-optical-nudge:1px}
.focus-preview[data-exterior-ring]{--specimen-optical-nudge:6px}
.focus-preview>*{translate:var(--specimen-optical-nudge) 0}
.focus-context{padding:0;border:0;box-shadow:none;background:transparent;width:max-content;max-width:none;margin:0}
.focus-preview .segmented-toggle{white-space:nowrap}
.focus-preview .segmented-toggle button{white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.focus-preview .qr-card{display:block}
.focus-preview .qr-copy{position:relative}
.focus-preview .focus-footer{width:calc(100% - var(--specimen-optical-nudge));display:block;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}
.focus-preview .focus-footer button{width:auto!important}
.focus-preview pre{max-height:160px}
.selection-preview{width:fit-content;max-width:100%;margin-inline:0;padding:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;background-repeat:no-repeat;color:var(--selection-preview-foreground)}
.type-row [data-type-sample].gate-error,.icon-sample>.gate-error{translate:var(--specimen-error-nudge) 0}

/* Isolate a typography sample from its copied ancestors' page layout, while
   retaining the real sample's font and component interior. */
.type-row .specimen-context:not([data-in-situ]){position:static!important;display:flow-root!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important;backdrop-filter:none!important;animation:none!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;overflow:visible!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.type-row [data-type-sample]{visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}
.type-row [data-type-sample]:not(pre):not(input):not(button){margin-block:0!important}
.type-row span[data-type-sample]{display:block}
.type-row .brand-name[data-type-sample]{width:max-content}
.type-row .specimen-context:has(>.controls-label){line-height:0}
.type-row .controls-label[data-type-sample]{line-height:21px}
.type-row .password-field[data-in-situ]{display:flex}
.type-row figcaption[data-type-sample]{text-align:left}
.type-row .qr-copy-overlay{opacity:1}
.type-row .copy-content{display:inline-flex}
.type-row pre{max-height:none}
.type-row .qr-card.specimen-context{width:max-content!important}
.type-row .footer-meta[data-type-sample]{display:flex;flex:none;width:100%;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:flex-start;text-align:left}
.type-row footer.specimen-context .footer-content{align-items:flex-start!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;text-align:left}
.type-row footer.specimen-context form{align-self:flex-start!important;justify-self:start!important;width:max-content!important}
/* Source samples stay available for parity measurements but only variants paint. */
.type-row.has-variants>.specimen-viewport,.has-variants>output{display:none!important}
.has-variants>.sample-label{margin-bottom:20px}
.button-variants{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;align-items:flex-start}
.button-variant{flex:1 1 160px;min-width:0;max-width:260px}
.feedback-grid{display:block;border:0;padding:0}
.feedback-grid .feedback-row{width:100%}

.alignment-surface{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));width:calc(100% + 2 * var(--optical-offset));max-width:none}
.alignment-square,.alignment-text{margin-inline:0}
/* Main page: preserve the 24px surface gutter and move the shared text rail to 28px. */
main:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder)>*{width:calc(100% - 56px);max-width:952px}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .step-copy,:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .controls-label,:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .description{padding-inline:0}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .step-row>article{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));padding-inline:calc(32px + var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .step-row>article>.code-wrap{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .card-heading{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .controls>.toggle,:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .controls>.sticky-control-slot{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .page-toolbar>.theme-toggle,:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .page-toolbar>.sticky-control-slot{margin-inline-end:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .page-header>.qr-card{margin-inline:-4px}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .footer-content>:is(form,.ph-form){margin-inline-end:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) footer.is-stacked .footer-content>:is(form,.ph-form){margin-inline:0}
@media(max-width:700px){:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder) .step-row>article{padding-inline:calc(24px + var(--optical-offset))}}
/* A prompt panel owns a new rail. Its square text area stays on that rail. */
.code-header{padding-inline:20px}.code-header>.copy{margin-inline-end:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
.code-wrap>pre,.code-wrap>.status:not(:empty){padding-inline:20px}
@media(max-width:700px){.code-header,.code-wrap>pre,.code-wrap>.status:not(:empty){padding-inline:16px}}
.access-gate{padding:24px}
/* Login uses the same scope, including hosted Playground login and held states. */
.gate-panel:not(.specimen-context):not(.focus-context){padding-inline:calc(32px + var(--optical-offset))}
.gate-panel #gate-title,.gate-panel #gate-description,.gate-panel .eyebrow,.gate-panel label,.gate-panel .gate-error{padding-inline:0}
.gate-panel>.password-field,.gate-panel>.gate-submit,.gate-panel>noscript>.javascript-notice,.gate-panel>.javascript-notice,.gate-panel>.javascript-notice-context>.javascript-notice{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));width:calc(100% + 2 * var(--optical-offset))}
.gate-toolbar>.theme-toggle{margin-inline-end:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
@media(max-width:660px){.gate-panel:not(.specimen-context):not(.focus-context){padding-inline:calc(24px + var(--optical-offset))}}
/* Dialogs and error surfaces are scopes too; their button interiors remain native. */
.perspective-dialog .perspective-dialog-content{padding-inline:calc(28px + var(--optical-offset))}
.perspective-dialog-content>form{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
.javascript-notice{padding-inline:calc(16px + var(--optical-offset))}
:is(#workshop-content,.page-placeholder)>noscript>.javascript-notice{width:calc(100% - 48px);max-width:960px;margin-inline:auto}
/* Playground page and all its normal/expanded panels. */
body:has(#playground-title)>.playground-heading header.wrap,
body:has(#playground-title)>.toolbar .wrap{width:calc(100% - 56px);max-width:1112px;padding-inline:0}
body:has(#playground-title)>main.wrap{padding-inline:28px}
[data-panel]>.panel:not(.is-expanded){margin-inline:-4px;padding-inline:28px}
.panel>.section-heading h2,.panel>p,.panel>.feather-notice>p{padding-inline:0}
.panel>ul{margin-inline:0}
.panel>.frame-wrap,.panel>#playground-icon-catalog,.panel>.samples{margin-inline:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);max-width:none}
/* The preview viewport stays on its rails; only its iframe may exceed it. */
.panel>.frame-wrap,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.frame-wrap{min-width:0;max-width:calc(100% + 8px);overflow:hidden}
.choices legend{padding-inline:0;margin-inline-start:0}.field>.slider-label,#hover .hover-explanation{padding-inline:0}
.choices>.choice-shell,.choices>.choice-options:not(:has(.choice-shell)){margin-inline-start:-4px;max-width:calc(100% + 8px)}
.panel-actions,.panel-options,.heading-actions{margin-inline-end:-4px}
.control-footer>.panel-actions{margin-inline-end:-4px}
.panel-actions>button:first-child:last-child{margin-inline-start:0}
.tab-scroll-shell{margin-inline:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset));width:calc(100% + 2 * var(--optical-offset))}
.field>input[type=range]{margin-inline:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px)}
#style-dialog{padding-inline:24px}
#style-dialog #style-options{top:-1px;right:-1px}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded{padding-inline:28px}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.frame-wrap,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-settings,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-state-settings{margin-inline:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);max-width:none}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.frame-wrap{max-width:calc(100% + 8px)}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-settings,.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.preview-state-settings{padding-inline:14px}
.preview-dialog.is-expanded>.section-heading h2{padding-inline:0}
.expanded-global-controls,.expanded-state-controls{padding-inline:4px;margin-inline-start:calc(22px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset))}
.expanded-global-controls>#global-style-controls{margin-inline:-4px;padding-inline:4px}
#perspective-replay{margin-inline-start:calc(-1 * var(--optical-offset))}
.panel>.feather-notice>details>.licence-text{margin-inline-start:calc(26px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset) - var(--optical-offset));padding-inline:20px}
/* Disclosure chevrons get their own measured ink correction; body text shares
   the summary's text position, not the enclosing panel's edge. */
.panel>details:not(.preview-settings):not(.preview-state-settings)>:not(summary),.panel>.feather-notice>details>:not(summary){margin-inline-start:calc(26px - var(--disclosure-ink-inset,5.25px))}
/* Nested grey specimen surfaces, swatches and catalogues own the same rails. */
.playground-icon-entry{padding-inline:28px}
.swatch strong,.swatch code,.swatch small{padding-inline:16px}.swatch p{margin-inline:16px}
/* Square textareas, tables and code listings deliberately stay on the text rail. */
#worm-copy-fallback,#perspective-copy-fallback{display:block}#worm-copy-fallback[hidden],#perspective-copy-fallback[hidden]{display:none}
.inspector-dock{padding-inline:max(28px,calc((100vw - 1112px)/2))}
.inspector-dock .inspector-bar,.inspector-dock .inspector-actions{margin-inline:-4px}
/* Sources already render their link interiors; align the whole link surface. */
.panel>a.workshop-link,.playground-icon-entry>a.workshop-link,.link-examples section>a.workshop-link{margin-inline-start:-4px}
.frame-wrap{padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.panel:not(.is-expanded)>.frame-wrap{overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:hidden}
#panel-url-reference h3{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:16px}

.page-placeholder article { --ph-surface:var(--card-bg); }

/* Preserve each fragment's intrinsic height even when its theme is hidden. */
.perspective { --egg-line: 24px; position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 1.2em minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows:auto auto; margin-top:max(40px,calc(var(--hover-height,60px) / 2)); margin-bottom:max(40px,calc(var(--hover-height,60px) / 2)); font-size:14px; line-height:var(--egg-line); color:var(--muted-text); }
footer:has(> .perspective) { display:block; padding-top:0; }
footer > .perspective { width:100%; }
footer.is-stacked .footer-content { justify-content:center; text-align:center; }
.footer-content { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px 24px; }
.perspective-fragment,.perspective-ellipsis { font-size:14px; line-height:24px; color:var(--muted-text); }
.perspective-fragment { margin:0; min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; position:relative; }
.perspective-day { grid-column:1; grid-row:1; text-align:right; }
.perspective-night { grid-column:3; grid-row:2; margin-top:calc(-1 * var(--egg-line)); text-align:left; visibility:hidden; }
.perspective-join { grid-column:2; grid-row:1; align-self:end; height:var(--egg-line); text-align:center; position:static; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .perspective-day { visibility:hidden; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .perspective-night { visibility:visible; }
.perspective[data-state="revealing"] .perspective-fragment,.perspective[data-state="complete"] .perspective-fragment { visibility:visible; }
.perspective-discover { position:absolute; left:100%; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); width:44px; height:44px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:0; appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; box-shadow:none; background:transparent; color:var(--muted-text); z-index:2; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .perspective-discover { left:auto; right:100%; }
.perspective[data-state="complete"] .perspective-join { position:static; }
.perspective[data-state="complete"] .perspective-discover { top:100%; left:50%; right:auto; transform:translateX(-50%); }
.perspective-discover:enabled:is(:where([data-capture-interaction-disabled]),.is-held) { scale:1; }
.perspective-discover[hidden] { display:none; }
/* All glyphs crop the same area-sized colour field, including the ellipsis. */
.perspective-fragment::after,.perspective-ellipsis::after { content:attr(data-sheen-text); position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; user-select:none; visibility:visible; color:transparent; background-image:var(--wave-paint,none); background-size:var(--wave-width) var(--wave-height); background-position:var(--wave-offset-x) var(--wave-offset-y); background-repeat:no-repeat; filter:brightness(var(--sheen-strength,1)); background-clip:text; -webkit-background-clip:text; opacity:0; }
.perspective-ellipsis { position:relative; display:inline-block; }
.perspective[data-sheening] .perspective-ellipsis::after,:root[data-theme="light"] .perspective[data-sheening] .perspective-day::after,:root[data-theme="dark"] .perspective[data-sheening] .perspective-night::after { opacity:var(--sheen-strength,1); }
:root[data-theme="light"] .perspective-particle { color:transparent; background:currentColor; box-shadow:0 0 1px currentColor,0 0 3px currentColor; }
/* Travelling twinkling points; the concealed glyphs never supply the cue. */
.perspective-particles { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:0; overflow:visible; -webkit-mask-image:var(--particle-mask,none); mask-image:var(--particle-mask,none); mask-size:100% 100%; mask-repeat:no-repeat; }
.perspective-particle { color:var(--agent-accent); position:absolute; left:var(--x); top:var(--y); width:calc(var(--size) * var(--particle-size,1)); height:calc(var(--size) * var(--particle-size,1)); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0 18%,currentColor 45% 65%,transparent 76%); box-shadow:0 0 2px currentColor,0 0 6px currentColor; opacity:0; transform:translate(var(--pull-x,0px),var(--pull-y,0px)) scale(var(--pull-scale,1)); will-change:transform,opacity; }

.perspective[data-celebrating][data-sheening] .perspective-fragment::after { visibility:visible; opacity:1; }
/* One rotating conic field supplies both the border and its blurred halo. */
.perspective-dialog { --halo-paint:conic-gradient(from var(--perspective-halo-angle),rgb(255 83 90) 0deg,rgb(255 183 70) 72deg,rgb(100 230 155) 144deg,rgb(65 200 255) 216deg,rgb(130 110 255) 288deg,rgb(255 83 90) 360deg); box-sizing:border-box; width:min(440px,calc(100% - 48px)); max-width:440px; max-height:calc(100dvh - 48px); padding:0; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:24px; background:var(--halo-paint) border-box; color:var(--text); overflow:visible; isolation:isolate; }

/* Fixed source-width examples must not trigger mobile text inflation.

/* One content inset. The surrounding iframe adds none. */

/* Scroll clearance, not a second content inset. The viewport reaches the grey
   boundary; its gutter restores the existing rail and protects focus paint. */
